questions.stem: Run-length encoding replaces each run of a repeated character with its count followed by the character, so AAAB becomes 3A1B. What is the encoding of `XXCCCXC`?

questions.stem: A program has 4 independent tasks that take 52, 39, 48, 10 seconds. The tasks can run in parallel on two processors, and each task runs entirely on one processor. What is the minimum time to complete all the tasks?

options.why: The longest task cannot run at the same time as all the others on just two processors.
